<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>A traffic light system with red, yellow, and green indicators, controlled by a pedestrian button.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n" width_description="1">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="clk" width_description="1">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="pass_request" width_description="1">Pedestrian request signal.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit output representing the count value of the internal counter.</output>
        <output id="red" width_description="1">Red light signal.</output>
        <output id="yellow" width_description="1">Yellow light signal.</output>
        <output id="green" width_description="1">Green light signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="idle">Idle state.</enum>
        <enum id="s1_red">State 1 - Red.</enum>
        <enum id="s2_yellow">State 2 - Yellow.</enum>
        <enum id="s3_green">State 3 - Green.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[7:0]" description="Internal counter for timing purposes."/>
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]" description="Current state of the traffic light controller."/>
        <reg id="p_red" width_description="1" description="Previous value of the red signal."/>
        <reg id="p_yellow" width_description="1" description="Previous value of the yellow signal."/>
        <reg id="p_green" width_description="1" description="Previous value of the green signal."/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= s1_red;
                cnt <= 8'd10;
                p_red <= 1'b0;
                p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                p_green <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    s1_red: begin
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                            cnt <= 8'd60;
                        end
                    end
                    s2_yellow: begin
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                            cnt <= 8'd5;
                        end
                    end
                    s3_green: begin
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                            cnt <= 8'd10;
                        end
                    end
                    default: state <= s1_red;
                endcase
            end
        end

        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n || pass_request && p_green) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else if (!p_green && p_green) begin
                cnt <= 8'd60;
            end else if (!p_yellow && p_yellow) begin
                cnt <= 8'd5;
            end else if (!p_red && p_red) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else begin
                cnt <= cnt - 1;
            end
        end

        // Output logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                red <= 1'b0;
                yellow <= 1'b0;
                green <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                red <= p_red;
                yellow <= p_yellow;
                green <= p_green;
            end
        end

        // Assign statements
        assign clock = cnt;
        assign p_red = red;
        assign p_yellow = yellow;
        assign p_green = green;
    </implementation>
</module>
